escena: SCENE (setting up a shoot, rooftop in Mexico City, late afternoon, NO faces): the hard low sun throws the long graphic shadow across pale concrete. At the top edge of the frame, where the person stands, an azure-blue equipment tarp is folded over a case and catches the light, putting the blue of the house into the scene as a real object. A single ORANGE sandbag sits on the concrete at the edge of the shadow, small and warm against the grey. The shadow's arm lifts at that instant. 35mm at f/8, camera high looking down. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.
